title: Video
description: Displays a video with a preview image. The video can autoplay or require user interaction to start.

poster_image.title: Preview Image - Desktop
poster_image.description: Thumbnail image shown before video plays on desktop.

poster_image_mobile.title: Preview Image - Mobile
poster_image_mobile.description: Thumbnail image for mobile. If not provided, desktop image is used.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Shape and proportions of the video player. Defaults to 16:9.

autoplay.title: Autoplay
autoplay.description: When enabled, video starts automatically on page load. Defaults to enabled.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: When enabled, video restarts automatically when it ends. Defaults to enabled.

muted.title: Muted
muted.description: When enabled, video plays without sound. Defaults to enabled.

controls.title: Show Controls
controls.description: When enabled, displays video player controls. Defaults to disabled.
